title: Reward Model Disagreement as a Proxy for Preference Distributional Shift

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible idea: ensemble disagreement as OOD signal. But the link from disagreement detection to actionable safety improvement is indirect without a clear intervention based on the signal.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Training 3-5 reward models, constructing OOD prompt sets, measuring variance, and correlating with policy degradation. Training multiple reward models is compute-intensive and complex for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Training an ensemble of reward models and measuring their disagreement across distributions requires multiple training runs and careful evaluation. Too broad for 30 hours at beginner level.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
